Questions people ask

How much will my house actually cost?

Somewhere between $20 and $60. Smaller houses land near the low end, bigger houses near the top. We confirm your exact price by email before the clean, and we agree it with you before any work starts — no surprises.

Do I need to be home?

No — as long as we can reach the windows, we can clean while you're out.

Which areas do you cover?

Aurora, Colorado. If you're just outside Aurora, email us at dawudjunaidwork@gmail.com and ask — we'll let you know if we can make it work.

Can you clean my shop or rental?

Yes — pick "Shop / storefront" or "Rental / move-out" in the booking form, or just email us. Those jobs aren't in the $20–$60 house range, so we'll price them by email first.

How do I pay?

After the clean is done and you're happy with the glass. We'll confirm the payment details in our reply email when we confirm your booking.

Can I book a regular clean?

Yes — windows get dirty again, so lots of people rebook every couple of months. Mention it in the notes on the booking form and we'll set it up with you by email.
